listing_rule: Monthly contracts listed for 24 consecutive months and any Jun and Dec in the nearest 72 months.
last_trading_rule: Trading terminates at 12:30 p.m. CT on the third last business day of the contract month.
expiry_rule: last business day of the contract month.
trading_hours: Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. (5:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. /CT) with a 60-minute break each day beginning at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 p.m. CT)

listing_rule: 9 monthly contracts of Mar, May, Sep and 8 monthly contracts of Jul and Dec listed annually after the termination of trading in the December contract of the current year.
last_trading_rule: Trading terminates on the business day prior to the 15th day of the contract month.
expiry_rule: Second business day following the last trading day of the delivery month.
trading_hours: Sunday - Friday: 7:00 p.m. - 7:45 a.m. CT and Monday - Friday: 8:30 a.m. - 1:20 p.m. CT

listing_rule: Quarterly contracts (Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec) listed for 20 consecutive quarters and serial contracts listed for 3 months
last_trading_rule: Trading terminates at 9:16 a.m. CT, 2 business days prior to the third Wednesday of the contract month.
expiry_rule: 2 business days prior to the third Wednesday of the contract month.
trading_hours: Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. (5:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. CT) with a 60-minute break each day beginning at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 p.m. CT).

listing_rule: Quarterly contracts (Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec) listed for 21 consecutive quarters
last_trading_rule: Trading terminates at 9:30 a.m. ET on the 3rd Friday of the contract month.
trading_hours: Sunday 6:00 p.m. - Friday 5:00 p.m. ET (5:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. CT) with a daily maintenance period from 5:00 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. ET (4:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. CT)

listing_rule: Monthly contracts listed for the current year and the next 12 calendar years. List monthly contracts for a new calendar year following the termination of trading in the December contract of the current year.
last_trading_rule: Trading terminates on the 3rd last business day of the month prior to the contract month.
expiry_rule: 3rd last business day of the contract month.
trading_hours: Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. (5:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. CT) with a 60-minute break each day beginning at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 p.m. CT).
